$note: The collection's words_to_avoid list, vendored. MrBinnacle/skills owns the list; this repository holds a copy so its per-commit check stays hermetic. scripts/drift_check.py DC-16 recomputes `sha256` from `words` on every run, so editing the array without editing the digest is drift. The collection stopped tracking its list file on 2026-10-24 (skills#630), so no automated check compares this copy with it. Change the list here by hand only to track a change upstream.
ruling: Operator ruling 2026-09-06: one voice across all repositories, every line of prose under the same rules. Filed for this repository as MrBinnacle/skill-harness#462, sibling of MrBinnacle/skills#261.
sha256_input: sha256 over json.dumps(words, separators=(",",":")).encode() - the array, not the file that carries it. A file digest changes whenever assets/tokens.json is edited for any reason: a color token, a spacing scale, a new known_gaps entry. A contract that reddens on unrelated edits gets muted, and a muted contract is worse than none. This digest changes exactly when the list changes, which is the event the contract exists to catch.
